Definition: from Ἐπίκουρος (compare G1947) (a noted philosopher); an Epicurean or follower of Epicurus:--Epicurean.
BiblicalUsage: Epikoureios is an Epicurean, a follower of Epicurus — and certain philosophers of the Epicureans and of the Stoicks encountered Paul at Athens, saying, What will this babbler say?
TheologicalSignificance: Men who sought pleasure and peace met a man who preached Jesus and the resurrection, and the babbler had the better news.
